body: What happened to the players now? It's been a struggle to get like 10 in a game recentley. Second question, is the website having random blackouts? Is this an issue? It keeps just giving me http 500 error. Thanks seniors, have a nice day.

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body: For your first claim, Avicus has dropped severely in player count. The senior advertising department will be hopefully pushing major advertising once atlas believes me (and believe me, Atlas is amazing. I've tested some of it) in hopes of bringing this server back. For your website problem, I have never heard of this problem. I've really never seen this problem so if you encounter again, mind sending a report to https://github.com/Avicus/Issues/issues. If you have any other questions, feel free to create a new thread.
